name: cohdit-hatch
description: Cohdit Hatch: say an idea in plain words, be interviewed, have it built, try it, share it at a free link. For people who don't write software. You need a Claude plan that includes Claude Code, and free GitHub and Vercel accounts, which setup walks you through. Hatch stores no passwords; what you build is yours.

plugins.name: hatch
plugins.description: Seven things you can say: set me up, I have an idea, build it, let me try it, share it, fix the bugs, status. Takes a non-technical person from an idea to an app their friends can open, on accounts they own. It can always tell you what it did and why.
